svg.text: The refnum and the error cluster go through SHIFT REGISTERS, not tunnels. A tunnel would hand the same starting value to every iteration; a shift register passes iteration N's output into iteration N+1.

Both right-hand tunnels are AUTO-INDEXING (the bracketed squares). One scalar per iteration goes in, a 96-element array comes out. Right-click a tunnel to toggle it — get this wrong and you get one number, not an array.

Everything right of the loop is array arithmetic on that one 96-element wire: Subtract twice, Max & Min for the per-cell margin, Array Max & Min for the worst one. No second loop is needed and none should be added.
